If any of the video buffer's background attribute bits are on, MONO converts the attribute to 70h (inverse video).

s.d: To ascribe (something) to a given cause, reason etc.; to affix.
To associate ownership or authorship of (something) to someone.
e: This poem is attributed to Browning.
We attribute nothing to God that hath any repugnancy or contradiction in it.

tr.g: 2. (transitive) To associate ownership or authorship of (something) to someone.

s.d: The ground forces actually fighting in a war or conflict, rather than troops not engaged or other military action such as air strikes.
e: The Pentagon may say we have enough, but that's not what I'm hearing from the boots on the ground.

s.d: The military policy of using ground forces.
e: So often boots on the ground is the American Way.

s.d: Personnel operating in an area of interest.
The state or condition of being physically present at a place of interest in order to ascertain the current situation.
Used other than figuratively or idiomatically: see boots, on, ground.

boots on the ground.et: First appears c. 1980 in the US. Attributed to the United States General Volney F. Warner, as quoted in the Christian Science Monitor (April 11, 1980) in reference to the Iranian hostage crisis

s.d: The state during 1649–1653, before the Protectorate in 1653–1659.
The state at any time during the Interregnum (1649–1660), including the Protectorate.
The second set of teeth formed in diphyodont mammals.
A burglar alarm.
Any cell that expresses cell surface receptors that deliver signals to either activate or inhibit a response as part of the innate immune system.

natural killer cell.et: The description "natural killer" refers to the fact that they do not require activation to kill cells missing MHC class I "self" markers.

s.d: A natural celestial object, visible in the sky, such as a star, planet, natural satellite, asteroid, comet, the Moon or the Sun. Objects flying or moving in the atmosphere are not usually considered as heavenly bodies.
An astronomical object.
The recreated, angel-like body that people will have in heaven.
